Subject: RE: High latency and errors impacting checkout (Retailocity) — preliminary findings

Team — brief preliminary notes from the bridge and early traces:

- Symptom window: 2026-10-30T15:38 — 2026-10-30T17:12 UTC (peak at 15:50).
- Root cause (prelim): a partial KV-cache invalidation coinciding with a model rollout for a smaller context variant. The invalidation caused increased KV misses which cascaded to longer generation time per request and concurrent connection saturation on a subset of replicas.
- Error signature: tokenization/decoder timeouts manifested as 504s and elevated 5xx at the inference gateways.

Immediate mitigations taken:
1) Rolled back the rollout (traffic shifted off variant) at 15:58 UTC — observed latency dropping toward baseline within ~8 minutes.
2) Increased KV-cache replication TTL and rehydrated cold keys for hot prefixes.
3) Applied temporary widened concurrency limits on affected pool to smooth client retries.

Requested follow-ups (owners):
- Full RCA doc (Karthik) — deliverable: prelim_rca.pdf by 2026-11-01 EOD.
- Exec one-pager (Jonas) — deliverable: exec_onepager.pptx by 2026-11-03.
- Permanent config change (Marissa & infra) — target rollout 2026-11-10 after validation.

We are also proposing a customer remediation package (one month of usage credit) pending leadership sign-off.

Karthik Iyer
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

1) Cause: KV-cache invalidation during a model variant rollout -> increased KV misses -> latency and gateway errors.
2) Immediate fix: rollback and cache rehydration (completed 2026-10-30).
3) Permanent actions and owners:
   - Config change: increase KV-cache replication TTL and add sanity checks (Owner: Marissa Cole, target 2026-11-10).
   - Deployment guardrails: rollout canary check added to runtime (Owner: Karthik Iyer, target 2026-11-08).
   - Monitoring: new alert on sustained KV miss ratio > 2% (Owner: Jonas Weber, target 2026-11-05).
4) Business remediation: propose one month of usage credit and waived overage charges for Oct 30 incident (pending finance approval).

Next steps: Kim to confirm the credit proposal and procurement steps with Retailocity; Marissa to schedule the infra validation window; Karthik to finalize the RCA PDF. I’ll be available for the customer exec readout call on 2026-11-04 at 16:30 UTC (please confirm).
